description: This Java source file defines the WebDavServlet class, which implements a WebDAV servlet by extending Jakarta's GenericServlet. It initializes request handler factories, security, and dispatcher components, and handles incoming HTTP WebDAV requests by delegating to specific request handlers based on HTTP method.

classes.name: WebDavServlet
classes.description: A servlet implementation that handles WebDAV requests by forwarding them to appropriate request handlers, managing dependencies like delegator, dispatcher, security, and a handler factory.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the servlet by loading delegator, dispatcher, security, and request handler factory from servlet context parameters, with error handling and verbose logging.

methods.name: service
methods.description: Handles incoming HTTP requests by attaching core components to the request, invoking the appropriate request handler based on HTTP method, and invalidating the session after processing.
